digest.component_or_area: Jira family rich-text codec / outbound mapper
propositions: Define a four-operation RichTextCodec Protocol (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) with AdfCodec for Cloud and WikiTextCodec for Data Center so the ADF-vs-wiki difference becomes a constructor parameter.
Cloud's ADF encoding is hardwired and PR #120 duplicated map_fields_to_remote to change one line; consolidate to a single shared implementation taking the codec as a dependency.

Four operations rather than two are required because _fit_description composes fit-then-normalize while the injected sanitizer fit uses fit only, and collapsing them would silently change Cloud behavior.
AdfCodec must live on the Cloud side (adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py) so jira_family/ never imports the location-pinned adapters/jira/adf.py, enforced by J2's import-contract test.
WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT=32767 with a shared truncation marker counted against the limit, while to_wire and decode_inbound are identity on strings.
Cloud behavior must be preserved and proven by J1's pinned oracles, and an allowlist test must ensure no new ADF references appear outside the codec.
